audit_member_text: Wet/dry decisions are written to MASKtmp at L91-L112 but the interface-depth correction at L130 tests the old MASK, because MASK is not replaced by MASKtmp until L141. Newly flooded cells still satisfy old MASK<1 and are treated as dry for DepthX/DepthY, while newly dried cells still have old MASK==1 and skip the correction.
